Guidance & outlook: We are planning for revenue growth of at least 60% in FY27 and believe growth may be higher, subject to execution.
We have already exported approximately ₹ 70-80 lakh in the first three months and are targeting exports of approximately ₹ 5-7 crore during the year.
For FY26, consolidated revenue from operations increased to ₹ 52.51 crore from ₹ 45.24 crore in FY25.
Growth & demand: We are targeting a minimum of 60% growth, with the potential to exceed this level.
Profit after tax grew by 23.31% to ₹ 8.75 crore, compared with ₹ 7.10 crore in the previous year.
This supports our confidence in achieving at least 60% growth, and we believe revenue can exceed ₹ 100 crore during the year.
Margins & costs: Manufacturing margins vary significantly by product and can range from around 30% to substantially higher levels.
Some products may carry margins of 40%, 50%, 70% or more depending on product economics.
In the reagent-rental model, margins can be around 40-60%, depending on the customer and commercial terms.
Capex & expansion: The new facility has the potential to support a substantially larger scale, with an indicated capacity of around ₹ 250-265 crore, subject to product mix, approvals, demand and execution.
The new facility can support peak revenue of approximately ₹ 250 crore, depending on product mix.

Benefits discussed for the park include concessional land, electricity at approximately ₹ 3.50 per unit, support toward employer contributions for ESI and PF, and an interest subsidy of approximately 7% on eligible plant and machinery funding, subject to applicable scheme conditions.
Balance sheet & cash: We will work toward improvement as operating leverage develops.
Government receivable cycles vary by tender and state.
We are evaluating debt funding, cash-credit limits, collateral-backed facilities and bill discounting.
Risks & challenges: A major challenge in this business is maintaining a well-trained service team and providing round-the-clock support.
Government tenders often require delivery within 45-60 days, and delays can result in penalties, blacklisting or forfeiture of the EMD.
